Use all three together -- do not rely on the mechanism report alone, and do not rely on general knowledge where the retrieved literature or patient data should govern instead.

## Drug combination

- Pegvisomant (DB00082)

Using the mechanism report above together with this patient's data and the retrieved literature, explain to the pharmacist:
